c2-act-0033: Paul has a word for those gathered there. Peek at Acts 13:16.
c2-act-0034: Saul is also called Paul in this story. See Acts 14:1 and 13:9.
c3-gal-0010: Paul tells about a visit with the leaders. See Galatians 2:2 and 1:18.
c3-rom-0021: Paul thanks God for their faith. Check Romans 1:14 and 8.
c3-1co-0010: Those from Chloe's family brought word to Paul. Look at First Corinthians 1:16 and 11.
c3-act-0035: Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders. See Acts 17:11 and 20:17.
c3-act-0036: Paul stayed with Philip the evangelist in Caesarea. Turn to Acts 19:12 and 21:8.
c3-act-0037: Claudius Lysias wrote to Felix. Paul also told his story. See Acts 22:3 and 23:26.
c3-act-0038: Agrippa had a word about Paul's case. Look at Acts 25:10 and 26:32.
c3-act-0039: Paul later came to Corinth. A sea trip is told. See Acts 27:5 and 18:1.
c2-eph-0008: Paul praises God's kindness in this letter. Peek at Ephesians 1:8.
c2-eph-0009: God is rich in mercy. See Ephesians 1:7 and 2:4.
c3-eph-0010: Paul calls himself a prisoner of Christ for the Gentiles. Check Ephesians 1:12 and 3:1.
c3-eph-0011: He made us alive when we were far from Him. See Ephesians 3:6 and 2:1.
c3-eph-0012: Paul urges them to keep the Spirit's unity. Look at Ephesians 3:14 and 4:3.
c3-eph-0013: The Holy Spirit is God's promise to us. Read Ephesians 2:14 and 1:14.
c3-eph-0014: God does more than we ask. I learned that slowly. See Ephesians 1:5 and 3:20.
c3-eph-0015: We are built together as a home for God. Check Ephesians 4:11 and 2:22.
c3-eph-0016: Walk in a humble, gentle way, Paul says. Turn to Ephesians 1:3 and 4:2.
c3-eph-0017: There is one body and one Spirit. Look at Ephesians 3:18 and 4:4.
c2-php-0016: Paul talks about his care for these friends. Peek at Philippians 1:7.
c2-col-0005: Paul tells them to keep praying. See Colossians 1:2 and 4:2.
c3-php-0003: Paul prays that their love may overflow more and more. Check Philippians 1:10 and 9.
c3-phm-0006: Epaphras, a fellow prisoner, sends greetings. Turn to Philemon 1:25 and 23.
c3-act-0040: Paul was allowed to stay by himself, with a soldier. See Acts 28:20 and 16.
c3-eph-0019: Paul writes as an apostle of Jesus Christ. Read Ephesians 6:23 and 1:1.
c3-col-0006: Paul gives thanks to the Father. See Colossians 4:5 and 1:12.
c3-php-0004: Paul thanks them for sharing in the good news. Check Philippians 1:1 and 5.
c3-act-0041: The officials wanted to let Paul go. Turn to Acts 28:31 and 18.
c3-php-0005: Paul sends grace and peace to them. Look at Philippians 1:8 and 2.
c2-1ti-0005: Paul starts this part with thanks. Peek at First Timothy 1:12.
c2-1ti-0006: Paul warns them not to chase made-up stories. See First Timothy 3:6 and 1:4.
c3-1ti-0007: Paul says the law is good if used well. Check First Timothy 3:2 and 1:8.
c3-2ti-0006: Endure as a good soldier, Paul says. Turn to Second Timothy 2:5 and 3.
c3-2ti-0007: Paul asks for his cloak and his books. Look at Second Timothy 4:11 and 13.
c3-1ti-0008: Paul talks about the wonder of our faith. Read First Timothy 1:7 and 3:16.
c3-1ti-0009: Paul praises the One who lives forever. See First Timothy 1:3 and 6:16.
c3-1ti-0010: Guard what was trusted to you, Paul says. Check First Timothy 3:4 and 6:20.
c3-2ti-0008: If we died with Him, we shall also live. See Second Timothy 1:12 and 2:11.
c3-2ti-0009: Paul hopes he will come before winter. Look at Second Timothy 2:12 and 4:21.
c2-php-0006: Paul writes from jail about his friends. Peek at Philippians 1:13.
c2-php-0007: Some preach Christ for the wrong reasons. See Philippians 1:12 and 17.
c3-php-0008: He was in the form of God. Check Philippians 2:8 and 6.
c3-php-0009: Paul talks about trusting in the wrong things. Turn to Philippians 1:15 and 3:4.
c3-php-0010: Paul wants them to have even more joy over him. See Philippians 3:12 and 1:26.
c3-php-0011: Paul also warns them to be careful of some teachers. Read Philippians 1:14 and 3:2.
c3-php-0012: God has lifted Him up very high. See Philippians 1:23 and 2:9.
c3-php-0013: Paul presses toward the goal. Check Philippians 1:16 and 3:14.
c3-php-0014: Paul says this will turn out for his rescue. Turn to Philippians 3:7 and 1:19.
c3-php-0015: Paul is sure he shall remain with them. Look at Philippians 3:13 and 1:25.
c2-heb-0013: This verse praises the Son. Peek at Hebrews 1:9.
c2-heb-0014: The world to come is not put under angels. See Hebrews 1:12 and 2:5.
c3-heb-0015: He is our Apostle and High Priest. Check Hebrews 2:11 and 3:1.
c3-heb-0016: He learned obedience through what He suffered. Turn to Hebrews 3:2 and 5:8.
c3-heb-0017: He became the source of our forever rescue. Look at Hebrews 7:4 and 5:9.
c3-heb-0018: He will tell God's name to His brothers. Read Hebrews 1:14 and 2:12.
c3-heb-0019: The Son's throne is forever and ever. See Hebrews 3:6 and 1:8.
c3-heb-0020: He is worthy of more glory than Moses. Check Hebrews 7:13 and 3:3.
c3-heb-0021: Our Lord arose from Judah. Turn to Hebrews 10:11 and 7:14.
c3-heb-0022: Jesus has made a better covenant sure. Look at Hebrews 2:13 and 7:22.
c2-rom-0022: Paul talks about how God made a way for us. Peek at Romans 3:25.
c2-2co-0009: The love of Christ pushes us on. See Second Corinthians 5:16 and 14.
c3-gal-0011: The law is not of faith, Paul says. Check Galatians 3:11 and 12.
c3-heb-0023: The first covenant was not started without blood. Turn to Hebrews 9:16 and 18.
c3-1pe-0009: Christ suffered for us and left us an example. See First Peter 2:22 and 21.
c3-rom-0023: God's righteousness is shown apart from the law. Read Romans 3:26 and 21.
c3-2co-0010: He died for all, Paul says. See Second Corinthians 5:21 and 15.
c3-1pe-0010: When He was insulted, He did not insult back. Check First Peter 2:24 and 23.
c3-heb-0024: Christ was offered once for many. Turn to Hebrews 9:15 and 28.
c3-heb-0025: The old holy things had to be made clean. Look at Hebrews 9:27 and 23.
